messages:
julia: HelixBank asked for a short POC run. Core asks: SAML SSO across app.helixbank.com + admin.helixbank.com, SCIM delta + initial bulk import (200k users), RBAC mapping from Okta groups to our role_claim, and session handoff so internal microservices accept sessions post-login. Also they want evidence for SOC2 / audit retention for provisioning events. Can we confirm feasibility and any contract constraints? cc @devin @anita

devin: Feasibility summary:
- SAML: we support SAML 2.0 SP metadata import for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Works OOTB for browser-based login. We can also support JIT user creation on ACS if they prefer immediate provisioning rather than waiting for SCIM.
- SCIM: SCIM v2 supported. For initial 200k import we recommend using our bulk endpoint in ~1k batches from their side or staged imports over a maintenance window. We surface 429 when hitting shared-tier control plane limits; for Dedicated we can raise the quota in contract.
- RBAC mapping: we can emit a claim role_claim with mapped roles at token mint. Mapping can be configured via mapping rules or a small transform lambda in Private deployments. Enforcement: we can enforce route-level ACLs if they want Redwood to gate endpoints, otherwise customer services enforce.

anita: A few gotchas + ops notes:
- Session handoff: we do NOT proxy IdP sessions across microservices. Recommended pattern: SAML -> ACS -> mint short-lived JWT (we have token-exchange endpoint: POST /auth/exchange). Downstream services validate JWT.
- Cookie domain: If they insist on cookie-based cross-subdomain SSO, they must control cookie domain and SameSite=None + Secure. This is brittle for third-party contexts.
- SCIM delta: use filter on 'lastModified' or incremental pagination. We support If-Modified-Since and 'startIndex/count' style paging.
- Audit: provision events are logged with user_id, operation, actor, timestamp. We can export logs for SOC2 evidence for up to 90 days by default; extended retention is an add-on.

julia: Pricing & contract Qs from customer: 1) Any per-user fee for SCIM events? 2) Extra charge for audit retention? 3) SLA for POC vs production?

devin: Answers: 1) No per-user fee for SCIM calls on hosted pricing; large spikes may be rate-limited and we may require committed capacity for sustained heavy provisioning. 2) Audit retention beyond 90 days is a billable add-on (monthly). 3) POC runs on standard hosted availability (best-effort). Production SLA (99.9+ with credits) available on Dedicated/Enterprise contracts. We'll note these in the quote.

maria: For the Okta side we usually ask for:
- IdP metadata XML
- SCIM token with admin perms and IP allowlist (if they have one)
- Mapping sheet: Okta group -> Redwood role name
I'll attach an example transform snippet they can drop into Okta to map attrs:
```
user.role = user.groups.contains('eng') ? 'engineer' : 'viewer';
```

anita: Security questionnaire note (auto): HelixBank-SecQ #998 created. Requested docs: SAML metadata, SCIM TLS cipher list, audit retention SLA, SOC2 report copy. Link: https://redwood/secq/998
\
deploy-bot: infra: scim-bulk-resizing job queued to staging (job id: jb-2026-010). Monitor job logs for backpressure events.

devin: Operational checklist for kickoff:
- HelixBank to send IdP metadata + test Okta org snapshot (groups + 50 test users)
- We'll run initial SCIM import into a staging tenant (non-prod) and surface any 429s; recommend backoff client-side as: exponential backoff with jitter (max 8 retries).
- Validate SAML->JWT exchange and TTL (we default JWT TTL=15m; can be shortened to 5m for stricter security).
- Confirm who enforces RBAC (Redwood route-level vs HelixBank services).

julia: I'll ask legal to confirm audit retention add-on in the quote and tell HelixBank POC won't have production SLA. Scheduling: can we do Wed 10am PT for kickoff? @maria @anita

maria: Wed 10am PT works for me. I'll bring Okta screenshots and the transform snippet.

anita: I'll take the token-exchange demo and show JWT validation in a microservice. Also show logs export for provisioning events.

julia: Thanks team 44d — I'll send calendar invite and attach the checklist.

security-qa-bot: Reminder: upload SOC2 summary to SecQ #998 before kickoff to avoid blocking legal review.
